key_findings: Fraxinus excelsior bark extract improved memory and cognition and preserved hippocampal histology in AlCl3-induced rat Alzheimer's disease, best at 200 mg/kg.
The extract raised MMP-2 activity, CAT and GSH while lowering MMP-9 activity and serum nitrite, indicating anti-inflammatory and antioxidant mechanisms.
